TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Rejects the creation of a pricing rule
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() reads pricingRuleId through getPricingruleid(), which returns null when the request parameter is missing or cannot be converted to Long, and passes that value to ABKOR006.executeRejectPricingRule. Inside the library, PricingRuleValidator.validateReject throws ABKO10000405 when PricingRuleRepository.getPricingRuleById(pricingRuleId) returned null. 2. Decisions and branches: RuleDetailsUtils.populatePricingRuleDetails only loads details when rule != null. processRejection(rule, status, ...) calls rejectRule with StatusEnum.REJ when status is PAA or PAU, and with StatusEnum.SYC when status is PAD. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: ABKOR006.executeRejectPricingRule loads the pricing rule with PricingRuleRepository.getPricingRuleById, populates detail values with RuleDetailsUtils.populatePricingRuleDetails and PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues, validates the current status with PricingRuleValidator.validateReject, obtains the audit sequence with PricingRuleRepository.getNextId, reads the request user code with getUserId, inserts the audit row with PricingRuleRepository.insertAudit, and updates the pricing rule status with PricingRuleRepository.updatePricingRuleStatus. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues throws ABKO10010004 when no query is configured for a detail entity type, when the resolved detail value is null or blank, or when queryForString raises NoResultException; PricingRuleValidator.validateReject throws ABKO10000405 when rule == null and ABKO10000412 when status is not PAA, PAU, or PAD; PricingRuleRepository.updatePricingRuleStatus throws ABKO00000010 when the update result is 0. executeRejectPricingRule catches PricingRuleException, adds an advice with e.getCode() and e.getDescription(), returns null, and execute() then calls assignSeverityError(this.getAdviceList()) to set Severity.EWR when the advice list is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: execute() calls setPricingrule(pricingRuleDTO) with the DTO returned by executeRejectPricingRule. setPricingrule assigns pricingRuleResponse only when pricingRuleDTO is not null; if the library returned null after an error advice, the output parameter is not added.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Rejects a pricing rule by loading it from the repository, populating its detail values, validating that its current status can be rejected, inserting an audit row, and updating the rule status. On PricingRuleException it adds an advice with the propagated code and description and returns null.
